name: overlay
description: Overlay services (BRC-22 submit, BRC-24 lookup; docs/OVERLAY.md): the engine judges submissions with the app's topic managers, hands each to the chain app (shruggr/skein-chain, required: chain/1) and admits it on the chain app's answer (accepted or proven), keeps what its topics admitted under <app>/state, and serves submit and lookup as route handlers; tm_demo and ls_demo are its example topic manager and lookup service (ls_demo's index under <app>/ls_demo). Its configuration is config.overlay, read from the app record <app>/app at every step; the install derives its wiring from it: http /submit and /lookup, libp2p <topic>, <topic>-admit, <topic>-proof (gossip, #74), and the box <app> from events and from the instance itself. Topics may also be registered at runtime: {fn: "register", args: {topic, program}} / {fn: "deregister", args: {topic}} in box <app> (the set under <app>/topics; subscribe / unsubscribe events).
